definition: Per chunk: Σ of the whole metadata.gas_profile of each FunctionCall-receipt outcome ('profile'; the VM burnt gas wasm_gas + actions + ext — the quantity oracle/v3-d3/src/d3.rs sums into fc_gas_burnt_for_function_call), else that outcome's gas_burnt ('outcome'; includes wiring gas, an overestimate).
note: Rows feed the operator's G_alpha checkpoint decision (STATUS-V3-D3 §4); re-fixing the value is a user decision.
